scope: Optional version-bound injection detection, conservative request origins, bounded failure handling and strict output delivery; not a classifier accuracy certification

verification.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

finalStateFollowUp.reason: Final monotonic detection wait placement adjusted after full regression: authoritative preflight completes before enqueue; queue and execution use the remaining monotonic deadline

policy.declaration: Optional InjectionCheck id, detector, reviewed revision, points, timeout, character cap and DENY/WARN behavior; max 16 checks
policy.binding: AgentControl validates required implementation and version before serving; freezes one immutable declaration snapshot
policy.signature: Declarations enter original policy digest; removing checks or weakening DENY to WARN changes fingerprint and receiver admission is denied
policy.legacy: Empty check declarations excluded from fingerprint, preserving the legacy policy digest
policy.decisions: CLEAR cannot grant permissions or elevate trust; UNKNOWN never becomes CLEAR; errors/unknown/limits use explicit fault behavior
policy.order: Deterministic hard denial precedes external detection; scan original then transformed effective payload; approval does not override detector refusal

boundedRuntime.timing: Queue/execution share monotonic deadline, bounded by session remainder; authorization preflight remains under existing task/RPC constraints
boundedRuntime.cancellation: Session revocation stops waiting and requests interruption; ignored interruptions retain actual worker slots, without expansion; late CLEAR does not revive failed work
boundedRuntime.isolation: Trusted Java plugins, not a sandbox; no remote classifier termination proof or automatic classifier billing ledger

sourceMarkers.derivedFrom: Actual intervention point and registered tool/resource handle; body claims and stored SYSTEM roles do not promote trust
sourceMarkers.controlFields: Outer data resource identity, operation and fragment fields removed from scanner content; source metadata retains opaque handle digest
sourceMarkers.limits: Request-bound origins, not byte-level trust propagation or source authenticity proof

httpAdapter.protocol: LLM Guard official POST /analyze/prompt; send only prompt field
httpAdapter.transport: Fixed HTTPS endpoint, host Bearer supplier, no redirects; literal-loopback HTTP only through explicit testing factory
httpAdapter.body: Full response deadline includes body after headers; bounded 65536 bytes; strict JSON and UTF-8
httpAdapter.validation: Exact response fields, exactly PromptInjection scanner, Boolean verdict, original input echo, official [-1,1] risk range and consistent validity; unknown or inconsistent responses never clear
httpAdapter.score: Relative service threshold risk mapped to [0,1], not a probability; sanitized content is never applied

audit: Only machine codes, hashed check/provider identifiers, reviewed-version binding, origin/trust and stage markers added; no detector body, raw provider exception or free-text explanation. Marker CLEAR refers to a check, not all-check safety.

spike.decision: Reuse an optional HTTP classifier protocol and trusted SPI rather than porting models or adding a second orchestration runtime
spike.validation: Official source/API/license reviewed; release-maintenance metadata endpoint was unavailable, so current support cadence is not certified; no model weights downloaded or production classifier deployed

limitations: No production neural classifier quality, model-weight/license review, multilingual robustness or long-input coverage benchmark verified
Character bounds do not prove tokenizer coverage; service matching/truncation policy must be reviewed
WARN and EVALUATE_ONLY are explicit availability/evaluation choices, not evidence of blocked injection
Signed configuration requires trusted receiver deployment; not remote proof that a compromised host ran its claimed plugin/model
External detector receives selected content; host controls privacy approval, service authentication, logs and retention
No arbitrary Java thread sandboxing, classifier remote-stop proof or automatic classifier cost budget
Post-tool detection cannot roll back already executed side effects
P0 production identity/platform/storage gates and P1 side effects, durable audit, approval and supply-chain work remain active
